# telnyx_calendar_connections (Data Source)

Lists calendar connections, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_calendar_connection`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `calendar_connections` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--calendar_connections))

<a id="nestedatt--calendar_connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `calendar_connections`

Read-Only:

- `auto_join_policy` (String) all_meetings joins eligible events; external_organizer_excluded requires the connected user to be the organizer; per_meeting requires an explicit opt-in.
- `bot_name` (String) Bot display name; null clears the override.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `default_assistant` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--calendar_connections--default_assistant))
- `default_barge_in` (Boolean) Default manual speech interruption. Cannot be true with default_assistant.
- `default_recording` (Boolean) Google Meet and Teams recording intent. When null, recording is enabled only if a destination is set. True requires default_recording_export; false cannot be combined with a destination.
- `default_recording_export` (Attributes) Customer-owned Telnyx Storage destination for recording exports. Uses the authenticated organization and user; do not supply credentials, region, organization ID or object key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--calendar_connections--default_recording_export))
- `default_summarize_on_end` (Boolean) Generate a summary when each future session transcript finalizes.
- `default_voice` (String) Manual-speech voice; must be null when default_assistant is set.
- `default_webhook_url` (String) HTTPS destination for future session webhooks. Null clears the default. A non-null update returns webhook_secret once; save it to verify signatures for sessions created with this default. Existing sessions retain their original signing secret.
- `id` (String) Calendar connection ID.
- `platform` (String) Calendar provider: Google Calendar or Microsoft Outlook.
- `platform_email` (String) Connected calendar email address.
- `status` (String) Connection status.
- `status_detail` (String) Additional connection status detail.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time.

<a id="nestedatt--calendar_connections--default_assistant"></a>
### Nested Schema for `calendar_connections.default_assistant`

Read-Only:

- `audio_gate` (String) Audio gating strategy in force for the assistant call leg.
- `dynamic_variables` (String) Dynamic variables in individual-session responses; null when none were supplied. Omitted from session list items. A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the assistant.
- `leave_on_end` (Boolean) Whether the bot leaves when the Assistant's conversation ends or fails.


<a id="nestedatt--calendar_connections--default_recording_export"></a>
### Nested Schema for `calendar_connections.default_recording_export`

Read-Only:

- `bucket` (String) Existing accessible bucket. Consecutive dots and IPv4-address names are rejected.
- `prefix` (String) Optional object-key prefix. One trailing slash is normalized. Empty path segments, . and .. segments are rejected.
